plugins.name: DSP Enhancer (Bass & Stereo Width)
plugins.description: Lightweight AudioWorklet DSP effect plugin chained onto getAudioContext(): harmonic Bass Enhancer, Mid/Side Stereo Widener, and lossless instant Bypass.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Local Library Share (LAN)
plugins.description: Share selected local music folders over LAN with PIN/Bearer authentication, scannable QR code, embedded <mplay3r-app> web UI, HTTP 206 Range streaming, and a remote LAN client for Web & Desktop.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Live Broadcast & Listening Party
plugins.description: Stream live playback to synchronized listeners over LAN/SSE (with latency compensation, listener counter, session token & optional Icecast push) or P2P WebRTC directly from Web Audio.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Podcasts & Streaming Sources
plugins.description: Search and subscribe to RSS/Atom podcasts (iTunes & Podcast Index), resolve streaming platform links to open RSS feeds, resume playback per episode, control speed (0.75x-2x), skip -15s/+30s, download episodes offline, and connect open MediaSourceProvider addons.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Web & FM Radio
plugins.description: Stream web radios and FM/DAB+ IP broadcasts via Radio Browser, direct Icecast/SHOUTcast/HLS URLs, ICY live titles, favorites, and ISP box micro-plugins.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Bbox Radios (Bouygues)
plugins.description: ISP box micro-plugin adding Bouygues Bbox local M3U radio bouquet (and French FM/DAB+ IP fallback streams) to the mPlay3r Radio plugin.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Freebox Radios (Multiposte)
plugins.description: ISP box micro-plugin adding Freebox multiposte radio channels (and French public FM IP fallback streams) to the mPlay3r Radio plugin.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Livebox Radios (Orange)
plugins.description: ISP box micro-plugin adding Orange Livebox local M3U radio bouquet (and French public/private FM IP fallback streams) to the mPlay3r Radio plugin.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: SFR Box Radios (Neufbox / Red)
plugins.description: ISP box micro-plugin adding SFR Box / Neufbox multiposte radio channels (and French FM/DAB+ IP fallback streams) to the mPlay3r Radio plugin.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Metadata Scraper (Cover Art & Synced Lyrics)
plugins.description: 100% opt-in metadata enrichment on track change: HD cover art (MusicBrainz + Cover Art Archive), synced .lrc lyrics (LRCLIB), persistent cache, polite rate limiting, and offline resilience.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Subsonic & Navidrome Connector
plugins.description: Connect to self-hosted Subsonic, OpenSubsonic, Navidrome, or Airsonic servers using salted MD5 token authentication, search songs/playlists, play random mixes, and expose a MediaSourceProvider.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Structural Themes (Winamp Classic & Hi-Fi Rack)
plugins.description: Full-layout structural themes built with registerTheme() and <ds-trigger>: Winamp Classic 2.x deck and brushed Hi-Fi Rack component with zero-interruption hot switching.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Cyberpunk Neon Jukebox Theme
plugins.description: High-impact visual Cyberpunk Jukebox structural theme: glowing cyan/magenta neon arch, spinning holographic cyber-disc platter, live Canvas 2D FFT neon spectrum & CRT scanlines on getAudioAnalyser(), illuminated A1-D4 jukebox track selector grid, and frameless desktop drag support.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Ember Noir Dark Neumorph Theme
plugins.description: Ultra-sleek matte charcoal dark-neumorphic structural theme with fiery ember-orange Play/Pause button, obsidian smoldering-rose circular medallion, ember-to-gold scrubber with glowing amber dot, dual Now Playing / Tracklist views, favorites persistence, and frameless desktop drag support.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Neumorphism Soft Studio Theme
plugins.description: Tactile soft-UI neumorphic structural theme with sculpted dual-shadow controls, concave LCD cavity, Porcelain Light / Graphite Dark toggle, <ds-trigger> controls, and frameless desktop drag support.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Prism Glass Periwinkle Theme
plugins.description: Luminous periwinkle & orchid glassmorphism structural theme: frosted translucent cards with crisp white rims, squircle-in-squircle artwork frame, double-ring glass buttons, coral-red Play/Pause, white/coral-dot scrubber with remaining time (-m:ss), Collections strip, floating frosted mini-player, and frameless desktop drag support.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Seventies Vintage Hi-Fi Theme
plugins.description: 1970s vintage hi-fi stereo receiver structural theme: walnut woodgrain side cheeks, brushed champagne aluminum faceplate, dual glowing analog VU meter needles driven by getAudioAnalyser(), warm amber/turquoise tuning dial, and frameless desktop drag support.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Audio Visualizers Pack
plugins.description: Lightweight audio-reactive visualizers powered by getAudioAnalyser(): Winamp spectrum analyzer with peak-hold, zero-crossing oscilloscope, WebGL GLSL shader, and fullscreen mode.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Winamp .wsz Skin Loader
plugins.description: Import classic Winamp .wsz skin archives (local file or URL), extract BMP sprites (main.bmp, cbuttons.bmp, eqmain.bmp), parse pledit.txt & viscolor.txt, and render an interactive <ds-trigger> skinned deck.
plugins.author: jezoock
